g.text: Comparison of fertility rates that account for survival of children
The total fertility rate considers all births per woman. In contrast, the effective reproductive fertility rate
considers only those expected to survive to their own childbearing years, and the effective labor fertility rate
considers only those expected to survive to working age.
Data source: Malani and Jacob (2024); UN WPP (2024); HFD (2025)
Note: Childbearing years is defined by the authors as the average of 15–49 years, while working age is defined as the average of 15–65 years
